title: Italian MotoGP
metaDescription: Italian MotoGP: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Motogp.

overview.about: The Italian Grand Prix is held at Mugello, a fast, undulating circuit in the Tuscan hills north of Florence, framed by a huge and colourful home crowd. Its kilometre-long main straight and flowing corners make it a rider favourite, and Valentino Rossi's seven straight wins here are the stuff of legend. The 2028 race is scheduled for 29 May - 1 June.
overview.nextEvent: The 2028 Italian Grand Prix is scheduled for 29 May - 1 June at the Mugello circuit in Tuscany. The long main straight produces some of the highest top speeds of the year, and the hillside crowd makes it one of MotoGP's great occasions.
